subject: Re: Kickoff: romanized language ID for ingestion routing
body: Status, week of April 20. Baseline repro done on B-A — our reimplementation matches the paper's reported setup within noise. The lexicon-augmented models are where the gains are: adding the Aksharantar romanization lexicons as training signal lifts macro-F1 by 3.4 points over the baseline, with the biggest jumps on the Hindi/Marathi/Nepali confusable cluster. Grunt-work note: the tooling assumes shared file root names (Assamese.tsv rather than asm.tsv), so Leilani wrote a normalization layer mapping B-A identifiers to Aksharantar codes and, where they exist, Dakshina codes. Open risk: Dakshina covers only a subset of the languages (no Bodo, Kashmiri, Maithili, Manipuri), so for those we have lexicons but no romanized supervision — accuracy there trails by ~6 F1. Proposal for the May review: a two-tier quality bar. — Rafael
